_comment: Draft narration for the current synthetic coordinator flows. Capture actual product only after exact-release acceptance; captions do not establish deployment. Existing production-tool schema and provider contract preserved.
_comment_length: Target 90–174 seconds, seven beats of 3–40 seconds. Draft timing only; measured audio/video and captions must pass existing gates before publication.

segments.captionText: A community-food coordinator needs more than a split. They need to know why one organisation receives food, why another cannot, and who will collect it. Merismos demonstrates that workflow with five invented organisations and synthetic donations. No real delivery or impact is claimed.

segments.captionText: Open the Merismos coordinator workspace with no account. Choose Add an offer, then Try success. The fields remain editable. Submit an invented donation and work out its split. This uses a real HTTP API, persistent session and the Strands agent dispatcher, not a prerecorded answer.

segments.captionText: The coordinator starts the review. Separate scheduled deferrals can append an escalation, not approve a publication. There is no automatic chat intake or message delivery. The public sandbox uses a scripted model with no model network call. Live records are separately read-only.

segments.captionText: Try refusal submits a broken cold chain: the result must not offer approval. Try correction submits an invented phone-shaped note: intake is refused and the fields remain available to correct. On a passing plan, inspect the exact text and address before consenting. Collection needs a separate explicit confirmation.

segments.captionText: Strands is load-bearing in tool dispatch. Its BeforeToolCallEvent guard cancels forbidden calls before invocation. CI tests remove that guard and then remove the SDK to demonstrate both boundaries. A separate deterministic gate checks the draft. The internal AWS runner retains configured Bedrock Opus 5, but configuration is not a model-call receipt.

segments.captionText: The evidence bundle keeps public sources, decision reasons, run and workspace revision, provider, mode, record history and handoff together. Hashes bind bytes, not source truth or delivery. Live recovery requires an authenticated coordinator and checks one reserved attempt without publishing again. Historical records are not silently repaired.

segments.captionText: Merismos keeps an allocation decision beside its collection handoff. Copy the evidence for your own review; nothing is sent automatically. Human active time, savings and food rescued remain unmeasured. Open the sandbox and try the three editable flows. Current CI, deployed release evidence and human acceptance are separate.
